codex.label: Binary path
codex.description: Path to the Codex binary used by this instance.

codex.label: CODEX_HOME path
codex.description: Custom Codex home and config directory.

codex.label: Shadow home path
codex.description: Account-specific Codex home. Keeps auth.json separate while sharing state from CODEX_HOME.

codex.label: Launch arguments
codex.description: Additional CLI arguments passed to codex app-server on session start.

claudeAgent.label: Binary path
claudeAgent.description: Path to the Claude binary used by this instance.

claudeAgent.label: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR path
claudeAgent.description: Custom Claude home and config directory. Keeps .claude.json and .claude separate.

claudeAgent.label: Auto-compact after
claudeAgent.description: Compact after 100,000 to 1,000,000 tokens. Leave empty to use Claude's default.

claudeAgent.label: Launch arguments
claudeAgent.description: Additional CLI arguments passed on session start.

grok.label: Binary path
grok.description: Path to the Grok CLI binary.

opencode.label: Server URL
opencode.description: Leave blank to let T3 Code spawn the server when needed.

opencode.label: Server password
opencode.description: Stored in plain text on disk.

antigravity.label: Sign-in method
antigravity.description: Google accounts use your subscription; API keys and Agent Platform bill usage.

antigravity.label: API key
antigravity.description: Gemini or Vertex AI express key. Stored in plain text.

antigravity.label: GCP project
antigravity.description: Required for Gemini Enterprise. Agent Platform uses it when no API key is set.

antigravity.label: GCP location
antigravity.description: Region for Gemini Enterprise or Agent Platform.

antigravity.label: Binary path
antigravity.description: Custom ACP executable. Leave empty to select automatically.

pi.label: Binary path
pi.description: Path to the Pi coding agent binary.

pi.label: Launch arguments
pi.description: Additional CLI arguments passed to pi --mode rpc on session start.

acpRegistry.label: Registry agent ID
acpRegistry.description: Agent identifier from the official ACP Registry, for example 'devin'.

acpRegistry.label: Executable override
acpRegistry.description: Executable on this environment. For registry agents, this overrides the distribution executable while keeping its arguments and environment.

acpRegistry.label: Authentication method
acpRegistry.description: Optional ACP authentication method ID. By default, the first agent-managed method is selected.

acpLocal.label: Executable
acpLocal.description: Executable name or path on this environment.
